## What changes for you?

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it. Link the issue.
Keep the local desktop experience primary, Mac first, then Linux/Windows.
Docker/browser changes are optional developer tooling.

## Scope and risks

List affected callers, tests, fixtures, configuration and public exports.
Describe any risk to your data, keys, permissions, accessibility or compatibility.
Do not include keys, personal data or private vulnerability details.

## Checks and evidence

List exact focused commands and real pass/fail counts. For a regression, state
how you reproduced it on unchanged code. Include what you did not check and
your next verification step. Use [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] You preserve validation, safety, consent, tenant isolation and charging checks.
- [ ] You preserve outreach disclosure, opt-out, suppression and caps where relevant.
- [ ] You preserve Mac app 0.1.108 compatibility without new native bridge commands or headers.
- [ ] You update affected documentation, tests, fixtures and exports without unrelated changes.
